research_notes: Blocked after official roster, personal and alumni biographies, historical NITV sources and targeted full-time searches. Need individual hours/contracts, dates within reported years, 1994 ABC overlap resolution and inter-parliamentary work coverage.

Official two legal-employment spells supersede alumni biography's broad articles 1998–2002 description. Alumni page also misdates a Port Arthur award and calls Corangamite a state seat; those claims are not adopted.

NITV government funding and later SBS ownership do not prove government control during Henderson's 2008–09 tenure. Recover contemporary constitution/control evidence if reassessing the nonprofit exclusion.
No job title or long career span establishes full-time status. Year-only labels remain intact; headlines unknown, not zero.
